what_this_is: The Workshop row that makes one database login held by every computer the person names and gives its grants: one generated value, put to each computer's vault through secrets:put, read back by name, then the role made on the always-on computer.

payload.label: Make a database login held by every computer of mine
payload.job: Make one database login, held under one name by every computer I name, and give it its grants, so each computer can open the database through its own vault
payload.description: Makes this computer's own database login for one pursuit, held in this computer's own vault under the shared name <login>-connection, and gives it its grants. Each computer runs it for itself: it makes its own password in the process, makes its own role (the role name carries the computer, so one computer's login can be revoked alone), puts the connection string through the engine's secrets:put on this computer only, reads the name back, then runs the login recipe (a-login) and the grants recipe on this computer's database. No value leaves the computer. The answer is {login, role, held_name, held_at, role_made, grants}; the password is in no answer, error or tool run.

login.description: The login's base name, e.g. <pursuit>_post_writer. Held as <login>-connection on this computer.

database.description: The database the login connects to and its grants apply in.

host.description: The database address the connection string names; the vault may send the value only there.

computer.description: This computer's short name, carried in the role name: <login>_<computer>.

operator.description: This computer's operator login held connection name (CREATEROLE). Required when make_role is true.

grants.description: Optional grants recipe to run after the role is made, as the database's owner.

make_role.description: true (default) makes the role; false only puts and reads back.

held_name.description: Optional vault name to hold the login under instead of <login>-connection, when its reader asks for a set name (the writer login the engine opens under a use: <database>-writer-connection). Ends in -connection.

provenance.source: New: the person's own door operation secrets:put (src/secrets.rs SECRETS_PUT), replacing the store-file write of `secrets put`.
provenance.note: Made by lane db-logins-every-computer, Nov 21 2026. Revised to one login per computer. The secrets:put right is granted per pursuit in the person's own listed row, not in this shared row.
